# Introduction

The **`decisioncalculator`** analysis (Medical Decision Calculator) provides clinicopathological researchers and biostatisticians with intuitive, publication-ready tools in jamovi and R.

## Key Capabilities

- Medical Decision Calculator for diagnostic test evaluation when you have  the four key counts: True Positives (TP), False Positives (FP), True  Negatives (TN), and False Negatives (FN). Calculates comprehensive  diagnostic performance metrics including sensitivity, specificity,  positive and negative predictive values, likelihood ratios, and  post-test probabilities. Supports confidence interval estimation and  Fagan nomogram visualization for educational interpretation. Presets and examples are illustrative only and are not clinical guides.
- Seamless integration between jamovi graphical interface and automated R syntax generation.
- Rigorous handling of missing data, small cohorts, and multi-variable stratification.

# Example Workflow in R

```r
library(ClinicoPathJamoviModule)

# Load package test dataset
data("decisioncalculator_test_data", package = "ClinicoPathJamoviModule", envir = environment())

# Run analysis with default settings
# ClinicoPathJamoviModule::decisioncalculator(
#   data = decisioncalculator_test_data
# )
```

# Clinical & Statistical Interpretation

Outputs generated by `decisioncalculator` include summary tables, diagnostic indicators, and high-resolution plots tailored for oncology, pathology, and clinical trial reporting.
